steps.en: Fill the fractured side first (fractured suffix: Dextral + Greater Exaltation for the resists)

body.en: When several lines are still missing Fill the fractured side first (fractured suffix: Dextral + Greater Exaltation for the resists) Use only Annulment and Chaos until one line is left Save Whittling or Erasure + Perfect Chaos for the last line Whittling or Erasure + Perfect Chaos costs about 25–30 div a try Whittling an unfinished item can remove the wrong line or shift a slot to the other side

steps.kr: 소멸의 오브로 분열 옵션과 잡옵 1개만 남김
steps.en: Annul down to the fracture and one junk line
